name: Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny
source:
A visual novel where the boundary between the living and the unseen begins to blur. Step into Jurnal Risa's world where each shadow holds a story, and every whisper leads you deeper into the unknown.

Witness the resurrection of the foretold nemesis of the Jurnal Risa crew, which was never revealed before. Unveil its dark destiny within this horror-adventure game. This is the tale of Jurnal Risa, as recounted to me by Risa herself.

This is the tale of Jurnal Risa, as recounted to me by Risa herself.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3417470/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这部视觉小说中，生者与无形之物的界限开始模糊。走进《丽莎灵异实录》的世界，每一处阴影里都有故事，每一声低语都会引你深入未知。

预言中，《丽莎灵异实录》团队的宿敌将要复活。你将亲眼目睹这段从未公开的往事，在这款恐怖冒险游戏里揭开它的黑暗命运。这是《丽莎灵异实录》的故事，由丽莎亲口讲给我听。

这是《丽莎灵异实录》的故事，由丽莎亲口讲给我听。
